Third-party components in this distribution
===========================================

bin\ffmpeg\avutil-61.dll, avcodec-63.dll, avformat-63.dll, swresample-7.dll
  FFmpeg 9.0.1 shared libraries (build reports "LGPL version 2.1 or later"),
  taken unmodified from the RPCS3 Windows build. Loaded dynamically for movie
  playback. Source code: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
  License: GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1 or later.

bin\SDL2.dll
  SDL 2.32.10 (https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL), the official release
  binary, unmodified. Game controller input (DualSense, DualShock 4, Xbox,
  Switch Pro and others).
  License: zlib license, Copyright (C) 1997-2025 Sam Lantinga
  <slouken@libsdl.org>. This software is provided 'as-is', without any
  express or implied warranty. In no event will the authors be held liable
  for any damages arising from the use of this software.

bin\msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll
  Microsoft Visual C++ runtime, redistributed app-locally as permitted by the
  Visual Studio redistributable license.

bin\Macross30Recompiled.exe
  Built with the ps3recomp runtime (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Ned Heller /
  sp00nznet) and statically recompiled game code.

Not included
  No original disc data and no PlayStation 3 firmware (dev_flash) files are
  distributed. Game data is extracted from the user's own disc image.
